name: twin-canvas
description: TwinCanvas — real-time collaborative design & painting for two people

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix server"
scripts.build: cd client && npm run build && cd ../server && npm run build
scripts.lint: npm run lint:server && npm run lint:client
scripts.lint:server: cd server && npx eslint src --ext ts
scripts.lint:client: cd client && npx eslint src --ext ts,tsx
scripts.typecheck: cd server && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../client && npx tsc --noEmit
